rows.quote: Druggable genome-wide Mendelian randomization (MR) was conducted to discover LUSC-related targets using expression quantitative trait loci (eQTL) and protein QTL (pQTL) in the ieu_b_4953 dataset and finngen dataset.
rows.coder_note: Sentence names the finngen dataset as one of the two datasets used; the dictionary has no row of this side for it.

rows.quote: The LUSC GWAS summary statistical data was downloaded from the IEU database (https://gwas.mrcieu.ac.uk/) and the finngen database (https://r10.finngen.fi/), namely ieu_b_4953 and finngen_R10_c3_HEPATOCELLU-CARC-EXALLC.
rows.coder_note: Sentence names the ieu_b_4953 dataset downloaded from the IEU database; the dictionary has no row of this side for it.
